'''Aine 23 (April 7)'''

==Events==
</noinclude>
*[[998 NE]] - [[Perrin]] and [[Egwene]] meet [[Elyas Machera]]. Perrin learns that he can talk to wolves.
*[[998 NE]] - [[Rand]] discovers that [[Mat]] has a dagger from [[Shadar Logoth]].
*[[1000 NE]] - [[Jahar Narishma]] proposes to the rebel [[Hall of the Tower]] that 47 [[Aes Sedai]] bond [[Asha'man]]. He also informs them of the ''[[saidin]]''-channeling woman who killed [[Eben Hopwil]].
*[[1000 NE]] - [[Delana]] and [[Halima]] flee the rebel Aes Sedai camp before they can be arrested.
*[[1000 NE]] - In the [[White Tower]]'s dining hall, the novices all stand in salute to [[Egwene]].
*[[1000 NE]] - The former [[Sul'dam]] Seta asks the Aes Sedai of [[Mat]]'s band to teach her to channel.
